parsed_json.up: Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy. Join: molecule_dictionary parent ON parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL493620'; molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno; molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno; compound_structures ON child.molregno = compound_structures.molregno; compound_records ON child.molregno = compound_records.molregno; docs ON compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id; activities ON compound_records.record_id = activities.record_id; assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id; target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid. Filter: activities.standard_type = 'IC50'; target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL612557'. Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, compound_key ASC, pubmed_id_or_doi ASC, assay_description ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC, activity_comment ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC, target_organism ASC.
